# TEN production diagnostics snapshot

Captured: 2026-07-24T05:48:30Z (UTC, this run)

This is a raw, unedited capture of live diagnostic output for the TEN production
deployment, taken as a follow-up to `docs/diagnostic-audit-2026-07-24.md`. No code
or config was changed to produce this file.

## Access method

**No direct PostgreSQL access was available from the sandbox that generated this
file** — `DATABASE_URL` / `TEN_DATABASE_URL` are not present in the environment,
and no `psql`/Railway CLI is available. The `pg_stat_user_tables` / row-count SQL
queries requested could not be run directly against production from here.

Instead, the three live production API endpoints below were fetched directly
with `curl` and their **complete, unmodified response bodies** are captured
verbatim in the sections that follow (each section also records HTTP status,
wall-clock fetch time, and response size, appended by `curl -w` after the body).

## 3. `GET /api/v1/dashboard/latest`

URL: https://ten-production.up.railway.app/api/v1/dashboard/latest

**Notable finding while capturing this endpoint:** a first fetch attempt with a
30-second `curl` timeout was cut off mid-response, having already downloaded
9,797,173 bytes (9.3 MiB) of a single-cycle JSON payload before hitting the
timeout. A second attempt with a 180-second timeout completed successfully in
~14.6 seconds, size 11,877,103 bytes (~11.3 MiB), confirming that number is
the actual full response size for one `/dashboard/latest` call, not a network
artifact. This is a single API response for a single analysis cycle on one
instrument (XAUUSD) — the body below is the complete, successful capture.

This also directly resolves an open question from `docs/diagnostic-audit-2026-07-24.md`:
the response body confirms live production has `"ai_centric_shadow_mode":true` and
`"ai_signal_proposals":true` (see the `feature_flags` object near the end of the
payload below) — i.e. the AI-centric shadow pipeline that writes `unified_market_states`,
`market_evidence_frames`, and `evidence_items` is actually **enabled** in production,
contrary to the checked-in repo default of `false` in `configs/feature_flags.yaml`. The
dashboard status is `"partial"` with real, populated `market_state` data — not the
`"pending"`/`"ai_centric_shadow_mode_disabled"` state the previous audit described as
the likely default-config outcome. An ~11.3 MB payload for a single cycle, if written
to the database in comparable form on every M15 candle close, is large enough on its
own to be a dominant contributor to the reported database growth rate.
